question_en: The field a distance $d$ from a long straight wire is $B$. What does it become if the current is increased by a factor of $2$ and the point is moved to a distance $2d$ from the wire?
question_uz: Uzun to'g'ri simdan $d$ masofada induksiya $B$. Tok kuchi $2$ marta oshirilsa va nuqta simdan $2d$ masofaga ko'chirilsa, induksiya qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: На расстоянии $d$ от длинного прямого провода индукция равна $B$. Какой станет индукция, если ток увеличить в $2$ раза, а точку перенести на расстояние $2d$ от провода?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. B = μ₀I/(2πd) ∝ I/d: tok ham, masofa ham ikki marta ortgani uchun nisbat o'zgarmaydi.
Asos: cheksiz sim maydoni.

distractors_en.A: the change in current was ignored
distractors_en.C: the change in distance was ignored

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.13-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A single loop is made from a wire of fixed length, and the field at its centre is $B$. If the same wire is wound into a coil of $2$ turns with the same current, what is the field at the centre?
question_uz: Uzunligi o'zgarmas simdan bitta o'ramli halqa yasalgan, markazidagi induksiya $B$. Shu simdan $2$ o'ramli g'altak yasalib, tok o'zgarmasa, markazdagi induksiya qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Из провода постоянной длины сделан один виток, индукция в его центре $B$. Если из того же провода сделать катушку из $2$ витков при том же токе, какой станет индукция в центре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. B₀ = μ₀NI/(2R), sim uzunligi o'zgarmas: N ikki marta ortsa, R ikki marta kamayadi — B ∝ N², 4 marta.
Asos: halqa markazidagi maydon.

rules.en: At the centre of a loop: $B_0=\frac{\mu_0NI}{2R}$

distractors.A: radius va o'ramlar ta'siri bir-birini yo'qotadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: считается, что радиус и число витков компенсируют друг друга

distractors_en.A: radius and turns were assumed to cancel

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», halqa maydoni g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The field inside a long solenoid is $B$. What does it become if the radius of the solenoid is increased by a factor of $2$ with the turn density and current unchanged?
question_uz: Uzun solenoid ichida induksiya $B$. O'ramlar zichligi va tok o'zgarmagan holda solenoid radiusi $2$ marta oshirilsa, uning ichidagi induksiya qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Индукция внутри длинного соленоида равна $B$. Какой станет индукция внутри, если радиус соленоида увеличить в $2$ раза при неизменных плотности витков и токе?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Amper teoremasidan B = μ₀nI — radius formulaga kirmaydi.
Asos: uzun solenoid maydoni.

distractors.D: B kesim yuzasiga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_en.C: the loop formula B ∝ 1/R was used
distractors_en.D: B was taken as proportional to the area

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.51-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two long parallel wires interact with a force $F$ per unit length. What does the force become if the current in each wire is increased by a factor of $2$ and the separation is increased by a factor of $2$?
question_uz: Ikki uzun parallel sim birlik uzunligiga $F$ kuch bilan ta'sirlashadi. Har ikki simdagi tok $2$ marta oshirilsa va simlar orasidagi masofa $2$ marta oshirilsa, kuch qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: Два длинных параллельных провода взаимодействуют с силой $F$ на единицу длины. Какой станет сила, если ток в каждом проводе увеличить в $2$ раза и расстояние между проводами увеличить в $2$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. F/l ∝ I₁I₂/d: toklar ko'paytmasi 4 marta, masofa 2 marta ortadi — kuch 2 marta ortadi.
Asos: parallel toklar ta'siri.

distractors.A: faqat bitta tok o'zgargan deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: считается, что изменился только один ток

distractors_en.A: only one current was assumed to change
distractors_en.B: the change in separation was ignored
distractors_en.C: the change in currents was forgotten
distractors_en.E: the force was taken as proportional to distance

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.23-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: In a long wire of radius $R$ the current is spread uniformly over the cross-section; the field at the surface is $B_0$. What is the field a distance $\frac{R}{2}$ from the axis?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan uzun simda tok kesim bo'yicha tekis taqsimlangan; sim sirtida induksiya $B_0$. O'qdan $\frac{R}{2}$ masofada induksiya qancha?
question_ru: В длинном проводе радиуса $R$ ток равномерно распределён по сечению; на поверхности провода индукция $B_0$. Чему равна индукция на расстоянии $\frac{R}{2}$ от оси?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Ichkarida qamralgan tok r² ga, aylana uzunligi r ga proporsional: B ∝ r, yarim radiusda B₀/2.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

rules.ru: Теорема о циркуляции: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0I$

distractors_en.B: the outside formula B ∝ 1/r was used
distractors_en.C: the field inside was taken as constant

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.63-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A toroid has inner radius $a$ and outer radius $2a$. By what factor is the field inside the toroid at the inner edge larger than at the outer edge?
question_uz: Toroidning ichki radiusi $a$, tashqi radiusi $2a$. Toroid ichida ichki chetdagi induksiya tashqi chetdagidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Внутренний радиус тороида $a$, внешний $2a$. Во сколько раз индукция внутри тороида у внутреннего края больше, чем у внешнего?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Toroid ichida B = μ₀NI/(2πr) ∝ 1/r; radiuslar nisbati 2.
Asos: toroid maydoni.

uz: Radiusi $r$ bo'lgan aylana $NI$ ni qamraydi: $$B=\frac{\mu_0NI}{2\pi r}\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{B(a)}{B(2a)}=2$$
en: A circle of radius $r$ encloses $NI$: $$B=\frac{\mu_0NI}{2\pi r}\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{B(a)}{B(2a)}=2$$

distractors.A: toroid maydoni solenoiddek o'zgarmas deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: поле тороида взято постоянным, как в соленоиде

distractors_en.A: the toroid field was taken as constant like a solenoid

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.57-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A current loop consists of a quarter-circle arc of radius $R$ and two straight radial pieces joining its ends to the centre; the current is $I$. What is the field at the centre?
question_uz: Tokli kontur radiusi $R$ bo'lgan chorak aylana yoyi va uning uchlarini markaz bilan tutashtiruvchi ikki radial to'g'ri qismdan iborat; tok $I$. Markazdagi induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: Контур с током состоит из дуги четверти окружности радиуса $R$ и двух радиальных прямых участков, соединяющих её концы с центром; ток $I$. Чему равна индукция в центре?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Radial qismlar markazda maydon bermaydi (dl ∥ r); yoy φ = π/2: B = μ₀Iφ/(4πR) = μ₀I/(8R).
Asos: yoy maydoni.
source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», yoy maydoni g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A semi-infinite straight wire ends at point $O$ and carries current $I$. Point $P$ is a distance $d$ from $O$ in the direction perpendicular to the wire. What is the field at $P$?
question_uz: Yarim cheksiz to'g'ri sim $O$ nuqtada tugaydi; tok $I$. $P$ nuqta $O$ dan simga tik yo'nalishda $d$ masofada joylashgan. $P$ dagi induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: Полубесконечный прямой провод заканчивается в точке $O$; ток $I$. Точка $P$ находится на расстоянии $d$ от $O$ в направлении, перпендикулярном проводу. Чему равна индукция в $P$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Kesma formulasida α₁ = 0, α₂ = 90°: B = μ₀I/(4πd) — cheksiz simning yarmi.
Asos: tok kesmasi maydoni.

distractors.B: P sim davomida yotadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: считается, что P лежит на продолжении провода

distractors_en.B: P was assumed to lie on the line of the wire

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.11-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The field at the centre of a loop of radius $R$ is $B_0$. What is the ratio of the field on the axis a distance $R$ from the centre to $B_0$?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan halqa markazida induksiya $B_0$. Halqa o'qida markazdan $R$ masofadagi induksiyaning $B_0$ ga nisbati qancha?
question_ru: Индукция в центре витка радиуса $R$ равна $B_0$. Каково отношение индукции на оси на расстоянии $R$ от центра к $B_0$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. B/B₀ = [R²/(R² + z²)]·[R/√(R² + z²)]; z = R da (1/2)·(1/√2) = 1/(2√2) ≈ 0.35.
Asos: halqa o'qidagi maydon.

distractors.E: dipol formulasi z³ yaqin masofada ishlatilgan

distractors_en.E: the dipole z³ law was used up close

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.33-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: On the axis of a small current loop, at a point far from it, the field is $B$. What does it become if the distance along the axis is increased by a factor of $2$?
question_uz: Kichik tokli ramka o'qida, undan uzoqdagi nuqtada induksiya $B$. O'q bo'ylab masofa $2$ marta oshirilsa, induksiya qanday bo'ladi?
question_ru: На оси маленькой рамки с током в далёкой от неё точке индукция равна $B$. Какой станет индукция, если расстояние вдоль оси увеличить в $2$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Uzoqda ramka — magnit dipol: B = μ₀·2m/(4πz³) ∝ 1/z³; masofa 2 marta ortsa, B 8 marta kamayadi.
Asos: dipol maydoni.

distractors_en.A: B ∝ 1/z was used as for a wire
distractors_en.B: B ∝ 1/z² was used as for a charge

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», magnit dipol g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A current of $5\ \mathrm{A}$ passes through a closed loop in one direction and $3\ \mathrm{A}$ in the opposite direction; a third current of $4\ \mathrm{A}$ lies outside the loop. What is the magnitude of $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l$ (in $\mathrm{T\cdot m}$)?
question_uz: Berk kontur ichidan $5\ \mathrm{A}$ tok bir yo'nalishda va $3\ \mathrm{A}$ tok qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda o'tadi; $4\ \mathrm{A}$ li uchinchi tok kontur tashqarisida. $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l$ moduli nimaga teng ($\mathrm{T\cdot m}$)?
question_ru: Через замкнутый контур проходят ток $5\ \mathrm{A}$ в одном направлении и ток $3\ \mathrm{A}$ в противоположном; третий ток $4\ \mathrm{A}$ проходит вне контура. Чему равен модуль $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l$ ($\mathrm{T\cdot m}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Faqat qamralgan toklar ishorasi bilan: 5 − 3 = 2 A; tashqi tok sirkulyatsiyaga kirmaydi.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

uz: Qamralgan to'liq tok: $$\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0(5-3)=2\mu_0$$
ru: Полный охватываемый ток: $$\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0(5-3)=2\mu_0$$
en: Total enclosed current: $$\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0(5-3)=2\mu_0$$

rules.ru: Теорема о циркуляции: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0I$

distractors_en.A: all currents were added without signs
distractors_en.C: the enclosed currents were added without signs
distractors_en.D: the outside current was also added
distractors_en.E: the currents were assumed to cancel completely

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.61-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Equal currents $I$ flow in opposite directions along the inner conductor and the outer shell of a coaxial cable; the shell's outer radius is $c$. What is the field a distance $r>c$ from the axis?
question_uz: Koaksial kabelning ichki simi va tashqi qobig'i bo'ylab bir xil $I$ tok qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda oqadi; qobiq tashqi radiusi $c$. Kabel o'qidan $r>c$ masofada induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: По внутренней жиле и внешней оболочке коаксиального кабеля течёт одинаковый ток $I$ в противоположных направлениях; внешний радиус оболочки $c$. Чему равна индукция на расстоянии $r>c$ от оси кабеля?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. r > c dagi aylana ikkala tokni qamraydi, yig'indi I − I = 0; silindrik simmetriyada B = 0.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

ru: Полный охватываемый ток равен нулю: $$B\cdot2\pi r=\mu_0(I-I)=0$$
en: Total enclosed current is zero: $$B\cdot2\pi r=\mu_0(I-I)=0$$

rules.ru: Теорема о циркуляции: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0I$

distractors_en.B: only the inner current was counted
distractors_en.D: half the current was assumed to cancel

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.67-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The figure shows the field of a long straight wire as a function of distance from the axis, $B(r)$. What is the total current in the wire?
question_uz: Rasmda uzun to'g'ri sim induksiyasining o'qdan masofaga bog'liqligi $B(r)$ berilgan. Simdagi to'liq tok qancha?
question_ru: На рисунке дана зависимость индукции длинного прямого провода от расстояния до оси $B(r)$. Каков полный ток в проводе?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Cho'qqi sim sirtida: R = 2 mm, B = 2 mT. I = 2πRB/μ₀ = (2·10⁻³·2·10⁻³)/(2·10⁻⁷) = 20 A.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

en: The peak of the graph is the surface of the wire, $R=2\ \mathrm{mm}$, $B=2\ \mathrm{mT}$: $$I=\frac{2\pi RB}{\mu_0}=\frac{2\cdot10^{-3}\cdot2\cdot10^{-3}}{2\cdot10^{-7}}=20\ \mathrm{A}$$

rules.ru: Теорема о циркуляции: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0I$

distractors_en.C: μ₀/(4π) and μ₀/(2π) were mixed up
distractors_en.D: millimetres and metres were mixed up

source: original (B2-L16, B(r) grafigi)

question_en: A current $I$ flows parallel to the axis along a long thin-walled pipe of radius $R$. What is the field a distance $\frac{R}{2}$ from the axis?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan yupqa devorli uzun quvur bo'ylab $I$ tok o'qqa parallel oqadi. Quvur o'qidan $\frac{R}{2}$ masofadagi induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: По длинной тонкостенной трубе радиуса $R$ течёт ток $I$ параллельно оси. Чему равна индукция на расстоянии $\frac{R}{2}$ от оси трубы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Quvur ichidagi aylana hech qanday tokni qamramaydi; simmetriyadan B = 0.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

ru: Охватываемый ток равен нулю: $$B\cdot2\pi r=\mu_0\cdot0\ \Rightarrow\ B=0$$
en: The enclosed current is zero: $$B\cdot2\pi r=\mu_0\cdot0\ \Rightarrow\ B=0$$

rules.ru: Теорема о циркуляции: $\oint\vec B\cdot d\vec l=\mu_0I$

distractors.A: tashqi formula r = R/2 ga qo'yilgan

distractors_ru.A: внешняя формула подставлена при r = R/2

distractors_en.A: the outside formula was used at r = R/2

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 12.69-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A current of surface density $K$ flows along an infinite plane. What is the field at any distance from the plane?
question_uz: Cheksiz tekislik bo'ylab sirt zichligi $K$ bo'lgan tok oqadi. Tekislikdan ixtiyoriy masofadagi induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: По бесконечной плоскости течёт ток с поверхностной плотностью $K$. Чему равна индукция на любом расстоянии от плоскости?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Tekislikni kesuvchi kontur: maydon ikki tomonda, 2Bl = μ₀Kl, B = μ₀K/2.
Asos: Amper teoremasi.

uz: To'g'ri to'rtburchak kontur, ikki tomoni maydon bo'ylab: $$2Bl=\mu_0Kl\ \Rightarrow\ B=\frac{\mu_0K}{2}$$
ru: Прямоугольный контур, две стороны вдоль поля: $$2Bl=\mu_0Kl\ \Rightarrow\ B=\frac{\mu_0K}{2}$$
en: Rectangular loop with two sides along the field: $$2Bl=\mu_0Kl\ \Rightarrow\ B=\frac{\mu_0K}{2}$$

distractors_en.A: the value between two sheets was used
distractors_en.C: the 2π from the wire formula was inserted

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», tokli tekislik g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two identical charges move side by side, parallel to each other, with the same speed $v\ll c$. What is the ratio of the magnetic force between them to the electric force?
question_uz: Ikki bir xil zaryad bir-biriga parallel ravishda bir xil $v\ll c$ tezlik bilan yonma-yon harakatlanmoqda. Ular orasidagi magnit ta'sir kuchining elektr ta'sir kuchiga nisbati nimaga teng?
question_ru: Два одинаковых заряда движутся рядом параллельно друг другу с одинаковой скоростью $v\ll c$. Чему равно отношение силы магнитного взаимодействия между ними к силе электрического взаимодействия?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. B = vE/c², magnit kuch qvB = qE·v²/c². Nisbat v²/c², chunki μ₀ε₀ = 1/c².
Asos: harakatlanuvchi zaryad maydoni.

distractors_en.A: the speed was counted only once
distractors_en.D: the forces were taken as equal

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», harakatlanuvchi zaryadlar g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A square loop of side $a$ carries a current $I$. What is the field at its centre?
question_uz: Tomoni $a$ bo'lgan kvadrat ramkadan $I$ tok o'tmoqda. Ramka markazidagi induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: По квадратной рамке со стороной $a$ течёт ток $I$. Чему равна индукция в центре рамки?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Har tomon d = a/2, burchaklar ±45°: √2μ₀I/(2πa); to'rt tomon — 2√2μ₀I/(πa).
Asos: tok kesmasi maydoni.

distractors.D: har tomon cheksiz sim deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: каждая сторона взята как бесконечный провод

distractors_en.A: the circle formula with a = R
distractors_en.D: each side was treated as an infinite wire

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 3.221-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A thin ring of radius $R$ carrying a uniformly distributed charge $Q$ rotates about its axis with angular speed $\omega$. What is its magnetic moment?
question_uz: $Q$ zaryad tekis taqsimlangan radiusi $R$ bo'lgan yupqa halqa o'z o'qi atrofida $\omega$ burchak tezlik bilan aylanmoqda. Uning magnit momenti nimaga teng?
question_ru: Тонкое кольцо радиуса $R$ с равномерно распределённым зарядом $Q$ вращается вокруг своей оси с угловой скоростью $\omega$. Чему равен его магнитный момент?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Tok I = Qω/(2π), yuza πR²: m = IA = QωR²/2.
Asos: aylanayotgan zaryad toki.

uz: Ekvivalent tok va yuza: $$m=\frac{Q\omega}{2\pi}\cdot\pi R^2=\frac{Q\omega R^2}{2}$$
ru: Эквивалентный ток и площадь: $$m=\frac{Q\omega}{2\pi}\cdot\pi R^2=\frac{Q\omega R^2}{2}$$
en: Equivalent current and area: $$m=\frac{Q\omega}{2\pi}\cdot\pi R^2=\frac{Q\omega R^2}{2}$$

distractors_en.B: period and frequency were mixed up
distractors_en.D: the radius was used instead of the area

source: original (B2-L16, aylanayotgan halqa)

question_en: Which of the following always holds for any static magnetic field?
question_uz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri ixtiyoriy o'zgarmas magnit maydon uchun har doim to'g'ri?
question_ru: Какое из следующих соотношений всегда верно для любого постоянного магнитного поля?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Magnit monopollar yo'q: chiziqlar berk, ixtiyoriy berk sirt orqali oqim nol. Rotor va sirkulyatsiya tok bor joyda nol emas.
Asos: ∇·B = 0.

uz: Magnit zaryadlar yo'q: $$\nabla\cdot\vec B=0\ \Leftrightarrow\ \oint\vec B\cdot d\vec A=0$$
ru: Магнитных зарядов нет: $$\nabla\cdot\vec B=0\ \Leftrightarrow\ \oint\vec B\cdot d\vec A=0$$
en: There are no magnetic charges: $$\nabla\cdot\vec B=0\ \Leftrightarrow\ \oint\vec B\cdot d\vec A=0$$

distractors_ru.A: там, где есть ток, ротор равен μ₀J
distractors_ru.C: для контура, охватывающего ток, циркуляция μ₀I

distractors_en.A: where there is current, the curl is μ₀J
distractors_en.B: a magnetic charge was assumed to exist
distractors_en.C: for a loop enclosing current the circulation is μ₀I

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», Maksvell tenglamalari g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two long parallel wires a distance $d$ apart carry equal currents $I$ in opposite directions. What is the field at the midpoint between the wires?
question_uz: Bir-biridan $d$ masofadagi ikki uzun parallel simdan bir xil $I$ tok qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda o'tmoqda. Simlar orasidagi o'rta nuqtada induksiya nimaga teng?
question_ru: По двум длинным параллельным проводам, находящимся на расстоянии $d$, текут одинаковые токи $I$ в противоположных направлениях. Чему равна индукция в средней точке между проводами?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Har bir sim d/2 masofada μ₀I/(πd) beradi; qarama-qarshi toklarda o'rtada maydonlar qo'shiladi: 2μ₀I/(πd).
Asos: superpozitsiya.

uz: Ikki teng hissa bir yo'nalishda: $$B=2\cdot\frac{\mu_0I}{2\pi\cdot d/2}=\frac{2\mu_0I}{\pi d}$$
ru: Два равных вклада в одном направлении: $$B=2\cdot\frac{\mu_0I}{2\pi\cdot d/2}=\frac{2\mu_0I}{\pi d}$$
en: Two equal contributions in the same direction: $$B=2\cdot\frac{\mu_0I}{2\pi\cdot d/2}=\frac{2\mu_0I}{\pi d}$$

distractors_en.C: the distance was taken as d
distractors_en.D: the distance was taken as d/4
